ev.q: CDC conducted an opt-in Internet panel survey of 1,944 self-selected HCP
Overall, 72.0% of HCP reported having had an influenza vaccination for the 2012–13 season
Vaccination coverage was higher for HCP in occupational settings offering vaccination on-site at no cost
Differences were noted when there was a difference of ≥5 percentage points between any values being compared.
Among HCP reporting that their employer required them to receive influenza vaccination, overall vaccination coverage was 96.5%
CDC conducted an opt-in Internet panel survey of 1,944 self-selected HCP
Vaccination coverage estimates from opt-in Internet panel surveys completed in 2010–11, 2011–12, and 2012–13 were compared to assess trends over time

methods_quotes.q: Because the study sample was based on HCP from opt-in Internet panels rather than probability samples, no statistical tests were performed
Sampling weights were calculated based on each occupation type by age, sex, race/ethnicity, occupational setting, and census region
Differences were noted when there was a difference of ≥5 percentage points between any values being compared.
